components.name: Primary Neon Button
components.description: Primary action button with neon lime background and tactile active scale.
components.css: .ds-btn-lime { background: #13ec5b; color: #000; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(13, 236, 91, 0.25); transition: all 0.2s; display: inline-flex; items-center: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-lime:hover { background: #0dcf4d; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-lime:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Pop-Up Vendor Pass Button
components.description: Electric purple CTA button for pop-up event vendors.
components.css: .ds-btn-purple { background: #9333ea; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.3); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-purple:hover { background: #7e22ce; } .ds-btn-purple:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Verified Price Tag Badge
components.description: Verified price pill badge displayed on shopper storefront pages.
components.css: .ds-badge-verified { background: rgba(19, 236, 91, 0.15); color: #13ec5b; border: 1px solid rgba(19, 236, 91, 0.3); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

components.name: Dark Store Card
components.description: Glassmorphic store card container with dark slate backdrop.
components.css: .ds-card-store { background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; color: #f8fafc; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card-store h3 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 900; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-price { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; color: #13ec5b; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: SurePrice V2 couples deep physical retail utility with high-contrast electric aesthetic clarity. Built as an in-store price tag and menu layer for physical supermarkets, dining venues, and temporary event stalls across Nigeria, the design uses a midnight backdrop (#020617) punctuated by vibrant neon lime (#13ec5b), electric purple, and warm amber accents.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Neon lime (#13ec5b) is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its high-chroma contrast is reserved for primary CTAs, price figures, and live status signals.

rules.name: The Naira Prominence Rule
rules.body: Price values always display the Nigerian Naira symbol (₦) formatted in bold display scale (font-black) with zero ambiguity.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat with subtle 1px border strokes (border-slate-800). Elevated glowing shadows appear strictly on primary action triggers or interactive hover states.

dos: Do format all prices in Nigerian Naira (₦) with explicit commas (e.g., ₦1,250).
Do use rounded-3xl for major outer containers and rounded-2xl for internal form inputs.
Do maintain a strict dark mode aesthetic with slate-950 as the root application canvas.
Do ensure all interactive buttons have explicit active scale animation (active:scale-95).
donts: Don't use plain generic colors; use tailored dark slates, neon lime (#13ec5b), electric purple, and warm amber.
Don't display price tags in USD ($) or non-Naira currencies.
Don't force app downloads on public scan resolution pages (/q/[code]).
Don't over-use neon lime accenting on secondary text or non-interactive borders.
